registration_context: Exploratory extension registered after the original OPT discovery and threshold results, before any paired OPT/MBJ outcome calculations in this work. The user selected method comparison and a candidate evidence list; no autonomous selection is claimed.
representatives: Use the already frozen representative/JID for each reduced composition; never choose a different structure by method or gap. Filter eligible nonexcluded discovery representatives before inspecting property values. Reject duplicate JIDs or family/formula keys.
pairing: A pair is the same representative row/JID with finite OPT, finite MBJ and valid finite ehull. Never pair by formula across structures, coalesce OPT/MBJ, or impute a missing MBJ.

contrasts.family_delta: chalcogenide observed screening pass rate minus oxide rate, separately for every arm
contrasts.subset_shift: opt_paired rate minus opt_all rate within each family, descriptive selection difference without a causal interpretation or independence claim
contrasts.paired_method_change: Within each family, mean(MBJ pass minus OPT pass) over identical JIDs; also report the chalcogenide-minus-oxide difference of these paired changes. Resample rows jointly for both methods within family, preserving pairing.

quality.family_status: data_limited if sample/coverage gates fail; inconclusive if either endpoint is degenerate or the interval contains zero; supported_in_snapshot if lower bound > 0; reversed_in_snapshot if upper bound < 0
quality.paired_scope: Conditional on the paired subset. Report paired coverage of all eligible representatives; low paired coverage prevents generalization to all compositions, not descriptive paired-subset calculation.
quality.paired_change_status: data_limited if either paired family has fewer than 20 rows; inconclusive if either family's paired differences are constant or the interval includes zero; otherwise direction_positive or direction_negative. These describe method sensitivity, not hypothesis replication.

candidate_rules: Each method has a pass/fail/unknown screening value. Unknown means its gap or valid ehull is unavailable, never an automatic failure. The shortlist is the union of rows passing either observed method. Report both-method passes, disagreements and missing comparator evidence separately, sorted by family then JID without a performance score. Keep all eligible rows in a local audit CSV.
next_validation_rules: Both-method passes: validate structure/stability and the intended physical target independently. Disagreements: targeted method/convergence and structural-input check on the same JID. Missing comparator: obtain that calculation for the same representative before a cross-method claim. No observed pass: no current shortlist priority; unknown evidence remains unknown.
interpretation: Computational screening audit of observed JARVIS representatives only. MBJ is a different computational method, not ground truth. A matching screen is not synthesizability, toxicity, photovoltaic performance or a new-material discovery. Report every arm, no engineered reversal or post-outcome window/threshold changes.
measurement: Record actual host scientific validation/computation time and output hashes. This standalone analysis uses no new model calls; do not claim autonomous adaptation or acceleration. Manual/model decision baselines and run-all comparisons remain later work.
